versions.changelog: Schema design, data imports, parameterized openCypher queries, transactions, bounded traversals and full-text search guidance for LadybugDB, with local Python helpers.

Updated against official Ladybug 0.21.2 documentation. Replaced legacy real_ladybug imports, pinned the runtime, added read-only-by-default execution, explicit write/create flags, parameter binding, timeouts, bounded output and deterministic cleanup. Added nine real-engine smoke tests, concurrency/migration guidance and per-agent OpenClaw availability checks. Community fork of trenza1ore/ladybug-opencypher 1.0.0 under MIT-0.
